english:
Finishers grant a matching buff to allies within 15 meters, based on the buff you have active:
• <arc Amplified /> for 15 seconds
• <void Devour /> for 5 seconds
• <strand Woven Mail /> for 10 seconds

Only one buff can be granted, prioritized in that order.

source.text:
On Finisher:
Allies within 15 metres are bestowed an Elemental Buff:

While Amplified is active: Amplified for 15 seconds.
While Devour is active: Devour for 5 seconds.
While Woven Mail is active: Woven Mail for 10 seconds.

Can only bestow 1 buff to Allies, prioritized from top to bottom.
